## Feedback type

Select one:

- [ ] Completed pilot session
- [ ] Setup or installation failure
- [ ] Analyst workflow problem
- [ ] Reviewer workflow problem
- [ ] Misleading or trivial divergence finding
- [ ] Important divergence the tool missed
- [ ] Protocol ambiguity or deviation
- [ ] Documentation problem
- [ ] Other

## Instrument version

- Branch or commit used:
- Browser and operating system:
- Did `npm test` pass before the session? Yes / No / Not run
- Did `npm run build` pass before the session? Yes / No / Not run

## Role

- [ ] Analyst A
- [ ] Analyst B
- [ ] Reviewer
- [ ] Facilitator
- [ ] Observer

## What happened?

Describe the behavior or failure plainly. Separate what you directly observed from what you infer caused it.

## Expected behavior

What did you expect to happen instead?

## Impact

- [ ] Blocked the session
- [ ] Materially affected a result
- [ ] Added substantial time or confusion
- [ ] Minor usability problem
- [ ] Cosmetic only

## Reproduction or evidence

Provide the minimum information needed to reproduce the issue. Redact names and sensitive material.

## Suggested change

Optional. A proposed fix is useful, but the observed failure matters more than the solution.

## Privacy check

- [ ] I have not included credentials, client information, private case evidence, medical information, participant names without permission, or other sensitive material.

Do not upload real investigative evidence to this public repository.
